title: Manifest Vegas 2027: Travel, hotel and restaurant guide
summary: Plan your Manifest Vegas 2027 trip with hotel, flight, budget, registration, dining, packing, and attendee tips for The Venetian.
body_markdown:
## Key takeaways


Manifest Vegas 2027 takes place Feb. 8-10, 2027, at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas. This guide covers where to stay, transportation from Harry Reid International Airport (LAS), budgeting for the trip, planning your agenda, navigating the Expo Hall, and preparing for departure.


- Rooms at The Venetian and nearby Strip hotels can fill up quickly during Manifest week, so compare rates, walking distances, and transportation options before you book.
- Conference-week hotel rates can run above Clark County's federal lodging per diem cap, so budget for the difference before you book.
- Use[Navan Edge](https://navan.com/product/navan-edge) , your personal travel assistant powered by AI and with human travel experts available 24/7, to book flights, hotels, and restaurant reservations in one chat.
- Build your agenda around your highest-priority sessions and meetings, leaving enough time to explore the Expo Hall and connect with other attendees.
- Send follow-ups within 48 hours while booth conversations, potential partnerships, and next steps are still fresh.


Manifest Vegas brings together supply chain executives, logistics service providers, technology companies, startups, and investors from around the world.\[1\] With sessions, exhibits, demonstrations, meetings, and networking events concentrated at The Venetian, a little planning before you arrive means you can spend more of the conference exploring relevant technologies, developing industry relationships, and gathering ideas your team can put to use.


## What is Manifest Vegas and who is it for?


Manifest Vegas is an annual supply chain and logistics technology conference taking place Feb. 8-10, 2027, at The Venetian Resort Las Vegas.\[1\] The event brings together supply chain executives, shippers, logistics service providers, technology companies, startup founders, and investors working across the end-to-end supply chain.\[1\]


Attendees come to explore emerging technologies, evaluate potential vendors and partners, attend educational sessions, meet with industry peers, and follow developments in areas such as planning, procurement, warehouse automation, transportation, supply chain visibility, and last-mile delivery. The event is particularly relevant to industry executives evaluating new solutions, logistics providers developing partnerships, founders seeking customers or funding, and investors tracking the competitive landscape.


Organizers expect more than 8,500 attendees, including more than 2,000 shippers and 1,500 startup and investor participants, representing over 60 countries. Manifest also expects more than 400 speakers in 2027.\[1\]


## What makes Manifest Vegas 2027 worth the trip


Manifest Vegas gives attendees opportunities to explore supply chain and logistics technologies in person, speak directly with potential vendors and partners, and connect with executives, founders, and investors from across the industry.\[1\]


Whether you're evaluating solutions, developing partnerships, tracking industry developments, or meeting potential customers or investors, the event brings together conversations and experiences that can be difficult to replicate remotely.


Plan your time around these in-person opportunities:


- **Expo Hall:** Explore supply chain and logistics technologies, speak with solution providers, and compare products and services in one location.
- **Conference sessions:** Hear supply chain executives, logistics operators, technology leaders, founders, and investors discuss developments affecting the industry.
- **Speaker lineup:** Announced speakers include leaders from companies such as Google, Toyota Motor North America, L'Oréal, Albertsons Companies, Target, Johnson & Johnson, and Unilever.\[1\]
- **Preconference programming:** Arrive Sunday evening or early Monday to attend Monday's preconference sessions and kickoff party.\[3\]
- **Evening events:** Use receptions and the official after-party to continue conversations outside scheduled sessions. Organizers recommend departing Thursday morning to avoid missing Wednesday evening's closing events.\[3\]
- **All-access pass benefits:** Receive access to conference sessions and the Expo Hall, along with breakfasts, lunches, three receptions, and closing entertainment.\[4\]


## Where to stay for Manifest Vegas 2027


Staying at The Venetian Resort can simplify conference days by keeping sessions, the Expo Hall, networking events, and your hotel room within the same resort complex. Nearby Strip hotels may offer additional choices, but compare the complete walking route and total cost before booking.

If convenience is your priority, staying at The Venetian or The Palazzo can reduce the time spent traveling between your room and conference programming. Harrah's and The LINQ provide nearby alternatives, while Wynn and Encore may appeal to travelers who prefer their accommodations and dining options. Check the complete route from your hotel room to the conference entrance rather than relying only on the distance between properties.


For additional hotel options, walk times, and loyalty-friendly choices, see our guide to[hotels near the Las Vegas Convention Center](https://navan.com/hotel-choices/las-vegas-convention-center) . Because Manifest takes place at The Venetian rather than the LVCC, you should prioritize proximity to The Venetian over access to the Convention Center Monorail station.


### Hotel pricing at Manifest Vegas 2027


Navan analyzed anonymized hotel booking patterns near The Venetian during Manifest week 2026 to provide context for 2027 hotel pricing.\[6\] Use these benchmarks while planning your stay:


- **Median hotel rate:** The median nightly rate was $221, compared with the $173 federal lodging per diem rate for Clark County in February 2027.\[6\]\[7\]
- **Stay length:** Business travelers booked an average stay of 2.4 nights.\[6\]
- **Late bookings:** More than half of the stays in this sample were booked within two weeks of arrival.\[6\]
- **Booking window:** Travelers who booked one to two months ahead paid a median nightly rate of $211, compared with $382 for those booking two to four weeks ahead.\[6\]


The official Manifest hotel block is open at The Venetian Resort for stays from Feb. 5-11.\[3\] The event currently says rooms are available at prevailing public rates, so compare the block with other booking options and review resort fees, deposits, and cancellation policies before reserving.


When booking through the official program, keep these points in mind:


- **Use the official booking site:** Access the hotel portal through manife.st. Manifest warns that companies independently soliciting attendees aren't authorized or affiliated with the event.\[3\]
- **Book early:** The organizer advises attendees to reserve early because rooms at the host property are expected to fill up.\[3\]
- **Compare total cost:** Review resort fees, taxes, deposits, and cancellation terms in addition to the nightly rate.
- **Consider convenience:** A higher rate at the host property may be worthwhile if it reduces daily transportation costs and travel time.


### Las Vegas flight trends


Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) is the primary airport for Manifest attendees and is approximately 4 miles from The Venetian Resort.\[3\] Navan flight data from Manifest week 2026 includes 6,119 business travel bookings to Las Vegas, with 21% originating outside the U.S.\[6\] The most common origin locations were Minneapolis, London, San Francisco, New York, and Detroit.


Arrive on Sunday, Feb. 7, and you'll have time to check into your hotel before Monday's preconference programming and kickoff party. Travelers arriving Monday should allow additional time to reach The Venetian and store their luggage before their first scheduled event.\[3\]

## How to budget for Manifest Vegas 2027 in Las Vegas


Plan your Manifest Vegas 2027 budget around the full cost of the trip, including registration, lodging, transportation, meals, and other travel expenses. Account for these costs upfront so you can set a realistic budget before booking.


### Federal per diem for Las Vegas


The U.S. General Services Administration sets federal per diem rates for lodging, meals, and incidental expenses. These rates apply to federal employees traveling on official business, although some companies also use them as benchmarks when setting travel budgets and reimbursement limits.


For Manifest Vegas 2027, the FY2027 rates for Las Vegas and Clark County are:


- **$259 per day combined:** Includes $173 for nightly lodging plus $86 for daily meals and incidental expenses (M&IE)\[7\]
- **M&IE breakdown:** Includes $22 for breakfast, $23 for lunch, $36 for dinner, and $5 for incidentals (reduce your meal allowance for organizer-provided meals when required)\[7\]
- **First and last travel days:** Includes an M&IE allowance of $64.50, or 75% of the daily M&IE rate\[7\]


The $173 federal lodging allowance is lower than the $221 median nightly rate in Navan's Manifest-week 2026 hotel data.\[6\]\[7\] If your company uses GSA rates as a benchmark, compare nearby hotels and account for transportation costs before choosing a lower nightly rate.


### Other expenses to consider


Planning for these expenses before you book can make it easier to stay within budget and avoid surprises when it's time to submit your expense report.


- **Conference registration:** The all-access pass is currently listed at $1,995, reduced from $2,895. Verify the current price before registering because rates are subject to change.\[4\]
- **Hotel:** The official Manifest block is open at The Venetian Resort, with rooms currently offered at prevailing public rates. Compare resort fees, taxes, deposits, and cancellation policies in addition to the nightly rate.\[3\]
- **Airport transportation:** Budget for a taxi, rideshare, or other transportation between LAS and your hotel.
- **Meals:** The all-access pass includes breakfast and lunch. Budget for dinners and other meals that aren't included, and check whether your company requires you to reduce your daily meal allowance for catered meals.\[4\]
- **Client and team dinners:** Restaurant prices vary considerably across The Venetian and the surrounding Strip. Reserve tables early if you're planning a group dinner.
- **After-hours networking:** Leave room in your budget for team dinners, partner events, and transportation after evening activities. The all-access pass includes three receptions and closing entertainment.\[4\]


## Plan your Manifest agenda


Manifest Vegas 2027 is confirmed for Feb. 8-10 at The Venetian, but the agenda, session times, Expo Hall hours, and badge pickup details haven't been published. The speaker lineup is available, and organizers have announced Monday preconference programming and a kickoff party, along with Wednesday's official after-party and closing entertainment. However, the official agenda page still features the 2026 program, so don't use those session details to plan your 2027 trip.\[1\]\[2\]\[3\]


Once the 2027 schedule becomes available, build your agenda around your highest-priority sessions, exhibitors, and meetings, leaving time for demonstrations and unscheduled conversations. Confirm the opening and closing times before finalizing your flights, and use our[business trip planning guide](https://navan.com/blog/edge/how-to-plan-a-business-trip) to coordinate your travel plans around the event schedule.


## What to pack and wear at Manifest Vegas


Business casual attire is a practical choice for Manifest Vegas, such as jeans or chinos, a collared shirt or blouse, a sweater, and comfortable shoes. If you're meeting with customers, investors, executives, or potential partners over dinner, consider packing a blazer or another polished option for evening plans.\[8\]\[9\]


February in Las Vegas typically brings daytime highs near 61°F (16°C) and overnight lows around 41°F (5°C).\[10\] You'll move between climate-controlled conference spaces and outdoor Strip routes, so pack layers that are easy to add or remove.


### Conference essentials


A few practical items can make long days of sessions, exhibits, demonstrations, and meetings more comfortable. Add these essentials to your packing list:


- **Two pairs of comfortable shoes:** Alternating shoes can help reduce discomfort after hours of standing and walking through the Expo Hall.
- **Portable charger:** Using maps, messaging, note-taking, photos, and event information throughout the day can quickly drain your phone's battery.
- **Reusable water bottle:** Las Vegas's dry climate and long conference days make it important to drink water regularly.
- **Lip balm and moisturizer:** Low humidity and extended time in air-conditioned spaces can leave your lips and skin feeling dry.
- **Throat lozenges and hand sanitizer:** Crowded conference spaces and hours of conversation can take a toll.
- **Light sweater or jacket:** Conference rooms may feel cool even when daytime temperatures outside are mild.
- **Small backpack or laptop bag:** A comfortable bag makes it easier to carry your charger, water bottle, meeting materials, and anything you collect from exhibitors.


## Getting from the airport to the Manifest venue


Harry Reid International Airport (LAS) is approximately 4 miles from The Venetian Resort.\[3\] Manifest recommends arriving Sunday evening, Feb. 7, or early Monday, Feb. 8, so you can attend Monday's preconference programming and kickoff party.\[3\]


For most attendees traveling with luggage, a rideshare or taxi is the simplest option. Travel time is typically 12-20 minutes but may increase with Strip traffic.

## Beyond sessions: Make time for exhibits and networking


Some of the most valuable parts of Manifest Vegas happen outside scheduled sessions. Leave time in your agenda for the Expo Hall, product demonstrations, exhibitor meetings, and conversations between events rather than filling every hour with conference programming.\[1\]\[4\]


- **Schedule meetings before you arrive:** Contact exhibitors, partners, customers, investors, and colleagues before Manifest to arrange booth meetings, meals, or coffee chats.
- **Plan around your priorities:** Review the exhibitor directory when it becomes available and identify the companies and technologies most relevant to your supply chain, warehouse, transportation, or visibility needs.
- **Map an efficient route:** Group nearby exhibitors together so you can spend more time in conversations and less time retracing your steps.
- **Leave time for emerging companies:** If startups and developing technologies are a priority, identify participating early-stage companies once the 2027 exhibitor information is published.
- **Take notes after each conversation:** Record important product details, questions, and next steps while the discussion is still fresh.
- **Follow up within 48 hours:** Send a brief email or LinkedIn message that references the conversation and identifies a clear next step.
- **Use evening events selectively:** Manifest has announced a Monday kickoff party and Wednesday after-party, along with additional receptions included in the all-access pass.\[3\]\[4\]
- **Build in short breaks:** Three days of sessions, exhibits, meetings, and evening events can be tiring. Leave time to eat, drink water, and recharge throughout the day.


The best networking begins before Manifest and continues after you leave. A smaller number of relevant conversations with clear follow-up actions will generally be more useful than visiting as many booths as possible or collecting contacts without context.


## What to eat at Manifest Vegas 2027


The all-access pass includes breakfast and lunch, making it easier to stay near conference programming during the day.\[4\] Keep water and a snack with you in case meetings run through a scheduled meal. For dinner, The Venetian and The Palazzo offer numerous options for client meetings, team meals, and late-night dining:


- **Client dinner:** Mott 32 at The Palazzo serves Cantonese, Szechuan, and Beijing dishes and offers group dining options.\[9\]
- **Steakhouse dinner:** Delmonico Steakhouse at The Venetian is open for dinner and works well for a more traditional business meal.\[8\]
- **Late team meal:** Grand Lux Cafe at The Venetian is open 24 hours and serves an extensive menu that can accommodate different preferences.\[12\]
- **Conference meals:** Breakfast and lunch are included with the all-access pass, so check the event schedule before making competing reservations.\[4\]


Reserve client dinners and larger team meals before you arrive, particularly if you need a private or semiprivate space. Navan Edge can book Las Vegas restaurants in the same chat where you arrange your flight and hotel.


## Finish strong on departure day


Manifest recommends departing Thursday morning, Feb. 11, so attendees can stay for Wednesday evening's official after-party and closing entertainment.\[3\] Before checking out, organize your receipts, notes, and new contacts so you're not sorting through the entire trip after you return home.


- **Pack the night before:** Charge your devices, lay out your travel clothes, and check the room for chargers, badges, and other belongings.
- **Confirm checkout arrangements:** If you have a later flight, ask the hotel about late checkout or luggage storage.
- **Arrive early at the airport:** Allow at least two hours for a domestic flight and three hours for an international departure, particularly when convention attendees are leaving Las Vegas.
- **Submit expenses early:** Upload receipts while the trip's meals, transportation, and hotel charges are still easy to remember, and note any lodging above your company's allowance.
- **Organize your notes:** Review product details, questions, and promised follow-ups before the context from your meetings begins to fade.
- **Schedule a debrief:** Block time early the following week to share useful findings, reconnect with new contacts, and turn ideas from Manifest into clear next steps for your team.


## Make the most of your Manifest Vegas 2027 trip


Manifest Vegas 2027 brings supply chain executives, logistics service providers, technology companies, startups, and investors together at The Venetian. Choose a hotel with a manageable route to the venue, build a realistic travel budget, prioritize the exhibitors and sessions most relevant to your goals, and leave room for demonstrations, meetings, and unscheduled conversations.


A little planning before you arrive can help you return home with a clearer understanding of emerging supply chain technologies, useful industry connections, and ideas your team can put into practice.
